# ProstaVive

> ProstaVive is a Prostate Health & Male Vitality Dietary Supplement. ProstaVive is a daily dietary supplement formulated for men who want to stay on top of prostate health, healthy urinary flow and everyday male vitality. It is taken as part of a normal daily routine, pairing well-established botanical and nutrient ingredients with a simple capsule format so it fits easily alongside your morning habits. This is a wellness supplement, not a medicine, and it is intended to complement — not replace — a balanced diet, regular activity and routine checkups with your doctor.
